messages:
maria: Need a tiny customer-facing one-pager for onboarding: caching, batching, streaming. Short, practical, with 2-3 runnable snippets. Goal: cut early churn from token surprises and latency.

lee: Sounds good. My shortlist to include:
- Edge cache TTL = 30s for conversational completions.
- Client micro-batching for bursty UIs (batch size 3-8).
- Use streaming for chat UX.

oscar: Add a simple validation harness customers can run: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-small","prompt":"sanity","max_tokens":64}'` run 10x, record median latency + token usage.

tara: Renewal signals to show customers: cache hit %, median token cost/session, streaming fallback rate. If cache hit < 10% after 7 days, flag for CS.

lee: Include an ops-safe pre-warm example: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-small","prompt":"welcome_back","max_tokens":8}'` scheduled daily. Phrase for customers: "Pro tip: pre-warm frequent prompts with a low-priority job."

oscar: Tiny JS batcher snippet for the one-pager:
```
let q=[]
function flush(){
  const b=q.splice(0,8)
  fetch('/api/generate',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify(b)})
}
setInterval(flush,50)
```
Note: tune interval by p95 latency target.

maria: Also advise a streaming safety net: if stream stalls >300ms, fallback to non-stream with a small token cap to avoid hanging UX.

tara: Troubleshooting checklist to give customers: pin model variant, confirm prefix caching matches tokenization, check routing if requests reroute.

lee: For renewals, CS question: "Seen any unexpected token spikes?" If yes: run validation harness, compare prompt distribution, open 24h triage.

oscar: Feedback capture: inline "was this helpful?" after stream, log anonymized prompt head (first 3 tokens) for debugging, surface top failing prompts weekly.

cs-bot: Reminder: create doc "CS Onboard - cache/batch/stream one-pager" and add reviewers: maria, lee, oscar, tara.

maria: Thanks team. Who will assemble? lee can draft copy; oscar will tidy snippets; tara will draft dashboard metrics.

lee: I'll have a draft by EOD.

maria: Great, will add to kickoff templates and mark medium renewal-risk accounts for week-2 proactive check. :thumbsup:
